chapters.title: One carrier, two faces, three relations

findings.title: The Jordan/TKK route reaches the Spin(2,3) hinge
findings.statement: For the declared four-real-dimensional carrier, Jordan translations, grading and a correctly typed continuous Furey channel rotation close the ten-dimensional real Lie algebra sp(4,R), hence Spin₀(2,3).
findings.boundary: This is a finite-dimensional model theorem, not evidence that nature selects the carrier or its interpretation.

findings.title: A concrete lower-rank Jordan entry point exists
findings.statement: The Gaussian residual selector is represented by the H₂(R) logarithmic barrier and its Peirce–Schur recursion. Its conformal/TKK algebra supplies an explicit local rung into sp(4,R).
findings.boundary: H₂(R) is not the exceptional Albert algebra; the later J₃(O), E₆ and E₈ continuation remains a separate bridge.

findings.title: The odd-cycle intuition has a projective double-cover realization
findings.statement: The three-relation cycle supports an odd-loop obstruction, a connected six-cycle cover and a coherent central-sign lift. Nested six- and twelve-step transports make the twist and return data explicit.
findings.boundary: Central −I holonomy is not automatically chirality, a spacetime braid, a Pfaffian reversal or a generation count.

findings.title: The central sign is not the missing orientation datum
findings.statement: The canonical projective lift returns the carrier frame by −I while preserving determinant orientation. The direct identification of Wilson-loop sign with response-Pfaffian sheet therefore fails.
findings.boundary: A separate reflection, oriented area or other odd datum could still supply a typed orientation bridge.

findings.title: The Furey channel rotation participates in exact sp(4) closure
findings.statement: On the declared response carrier, the continuous Furey product rotation supplies the generator that enlarges the compact-turn/split-dilation subalgebra to sp(4,R).
findings.boundary: The response operator is an effective typed construction, not a microscopic Standard-Model Hamiltonian or a theorem about Furey's complete programme.

findings.title: One S₁ mediator cannot realize the desired pure Furey pulse
findings.statement: The common mediator producing the two crossed Standard-Model operators also produces a third Wilson edge. One copy is rank-obstructed; common-orientation positive copies do not remove it.
findings.boundary: A split-copy involution, source-incidence rule, boundary realization or physical reading of the closed triangle remains possible only with additional structure.

findings.title: Proton safety is a source-selection problem
findings.statement: The complete unified triplet contains the desired leptoquark arms together with four-quark and proton-decay channels. B−L and matter parity do not isolate the safe subset.
findings.boundary: This excludes the naive complete-multiplet reading, not every Pati–Salam, finite-geometry or multi-mediator completion.

findings.title: Pati–Salam finite geometry supplies a concrete source split
findings.statement: The retained Model C reconstruction separates leptoquark and diquark sources and reproduces opposite crossed coefficients; rank-one vacuum geometry protects selected mixing channels through the audited orders.
findings.boundary: Broken-phase counterterms, global anomalies and the third-edge burden remain open.

findings.title: The simplest continuous and binary protections fail
findings.statement: Family-universal anomaly-free U(1) charges reduce to familiar directions and cannot distinguish the safe mask. A universal internal Z₂ is weak-anomalous for an odd family count, while connected flavor removes the two-family sign exit.
findings.boundary: Larger cyclic, flavor-dependent, non-Abelian, inflow and finite-geometry mechanisms remain live.

findings.title: Baryon triality is the first surviving cyclic protection
findings.statement: The first family-universal cyclic witness appears at Z₉; quotienting its gauge cube leaves baryon triality. Three families cancel the audited low-energy residues.
findings.boundary: The full Pati–Salam bordism class, heavy-threshold descent and exact finite-spectral-triple normalizer remain open.

findings.title: The exceptional continuation remains a separate bridge
findings.statement: The local H₂(R)/TKK result strengthens the route into Spin(2,3), but does not derive J₃(O), E₆, E₈, Golay, Leech or Monster structure.
findings.boundary: Shared dimensions, labels and visual resemblance are not carrier maps; each continuation needs an explicit map, invariant and observable.

findings.title: Mathematical closure is not physical closure
findings.statement: The programme contains reproducible algebraic closure and microscopic candidates, but no selected action, vacuum, measure, recovered Standard-Model spectrum or target-blind prediction follows from closure alone.
findings.boundary: This is the principal firewall against presenting the programme as a completed theory of nature.

frontiers.title: Reconstruct the closure independently
frontiers.question: Does the three-generator Jordan/Furey set close to sp(4,R) under an independent basis and sign convention?
frontiers.advance: A second implementation reproduces dimension ten, brackets, real form and the Spin₀(2,3) identification.
frontiers.stop: Downgrade the central result if closure depends on tuned transcription, a hidden quotient or an inconsistent real form.

frontiers.title: Derive rather than name the physical carrier
frontiers.question: What microscopic system supplies the four-real-dimensional carrier and its generators?
frontiers.advance: One action yields the carrier, symplectic form and normalization without branch-specific insertion.
frontiers.stop: Keep the result mathematical if the carrier remains an interpretive assignment.

frontiers.title: Resolve the third Wilson edge
frontiers.question: Is the forced third edge observable structure, a boundary term or a fatal mismatch?
frontiers.advance: A source-derived mechanism predicts its coefficient and survives loop and flavor tests.
frontiers.stop: Close pure-star candidates that delete the edge without a symmetry or incidence theorem.

frontiers.title: Complete proton-safe source selection
frontiers.question: Can a full finite spectral triple derive the safe leptoquark sector while suppressing every diquark partner?
frontiers.advance: The one-form calculus, kinetic metric, vacuum and counterterms preserve the mask.
frontiers.stop: Reject candidates with unprotected companion mixing or a forbidden proton-decay rate.

frontiers.title: Transport baryon triality through the ultraviolet theory
frontiers.question: Does the Z₉ representative and Z₃ observable quotient survive the global group, bordism class and heavy thresholds?
frontiers.advance: A complete anomaly and Higgs-descent calculation returns triality without extra assumptions.
frontiers.stop: Close the protection if a global anomaly or threshold operator regenerates the forbidden channel.

frontiers.title: Separate central sign, orientation and chirality
frontiers.question: Can one typed map connect projective sign to an independently odd datum and then to a protected chiral observable?
frontiers.advance: The same map preserves carrier, symmetry action and measurable phase through all stages.
frontiers.stop: Keep the notions separate if the bridge changes representation or silently inserts reflection.

frontiers.title: Cross the exceptional real-form seam
frontiers.question: Can the local real Jordan carrier enter an exceptional state domain while preserving positivity, cubic structure and noncompact action?
frontiers.advance: An explicit real-form map preserves a nontrivial invariant and a declared physical observable.
frontiers.stop: Retain adjacency only if the constructions meet merely through dimensions, labels or analogy.

frontiers.title: Demand one target-blind observable
frontiers.question: What prospective measurement differs from established physics after parameters and selectors are frozen?
frontiers.advance: A preregistered observable survives controls, flat-limit recovery and independent analysis.
frontiers.stop: Do not call the programme physical closure while every comparison remains retrospective or convention-selected.
